meta.name: Sorcerer
meta.title: Sorcerer Ascension Planner
meta.sub: AION 2 Global · PvE Hellfire build · exact skill points and Daevanion crystals, level by level
meta.blurb: Ranged magic DPS. Charged Hellfire on its own key, a short fire and frost macro.

text.levels: Cost to raise a skill one level: 1 point each for levels 2–4, 2 each for 5–7, 4 each for 8–10 (13 to reach 8, 21 to reach 10). A skill level opens 3 character levels after the one before it. Levels alone give 203 points by 45; Wisdom Stones from district quests and sealed dungeons add up to 180 more for the 45 build.
text.schedule: Hellfire and Firestorm first on each board as it opens, then Blaze and Bittercold Wind on Nezekan and Zikel, and the Combat Speed and Damage Boost corners. Skip Frost, Defiance, Flame Scattershot, Multi-Hit Resist, Critical Damage Tolerance, MP and Critical Hit Resist except where the board forces a step.
text.build: At 45, reset (free) and spend in this order. Levels alone pay for rows 1–5; Wisdom Stones from district quests and sealed dungeons pay for the rest. Leave at 1: Grace of Resistance, Revitalization Contract, Absorb Essence and whichever of Cold Snap or Robe of Cold you skip. 5 points stay spare.
text.passives: Robe of Earth's Critical Hit works only at 50% MP or more and Grace of Enhancement's +20% PvE Damage Boost at 25% or more, so keep MP up. Element Enhancement at Stigma 10 makes Robe of Flame count ×1.5.
text.specs: Skill levels past 10 come from Daevanion nodes (+1 each), Arcana cards and gear lines. First level-16 picks to chase: Wish of Concentration −10s all cooldowns, Hellfire −15s cooldown.
text.stigmaSub: 30 points at 45: Element Enhancement 10, the rest 5
text.stigma: Take each to 5 as the next slot opens; from level 40 the new points take Element Enhancement to 10. Swaps: Steel Barrier for Delayed Explosion while levelling solo, Divine Burst for Cold Storm on stagger checks, Glacial Smite against bosses that keep moving.
text.src: Where guides disagree (board order, a few Specialty picks, the Cold Snap vs Robe of Cold passive) this planner follows Aion 2 Maps, whose stepper is computed from the client's level gates and point curve. Numbers can change with patches; the in-game tooltip wins.

Flame Arrow.role: Basic attack, restores MP. Hold it between skills.

spec.12: +5% Fire Damage Boost for 10s on activating [Pyroclasm]

Ice Chain.role: No-cooldown pack skill: hits up to 4 within 4 m and slows 40%.

spec.12: -1s [Winter's Shackles] cooldown on hit (or: up to 12% more damage when fewer targets are hit)

Firestorm.role: Five fireballs; at skill 12 each hit takes 2 s off Hellfire.

spec.12: -2s [Hellfire] cooldown per fireball (the key pick: brings Hellfire back sooner)

Bittercold Wind.role: Water area summon; its Pull effect gathers packs.

spec.12: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit

Blaze.role: Fire hit that consumes Fire Mark; press when it lights up.

Flame Scattershot.role: Hits only a staggered target. Use in stagger windows.

spec.12: -1s all skill cooldowns on hit, then Multi-Hit on hit

Frost.role: Freezes target 3 s; sets up Frost Burst on trash.

spec.45: Reset [Frost Burst] cooldown on landing Frost (trash preset)

Winter's Shackles.role: Water CC with a 5 s damage buff on landing.

spec.8: +20% PvE Damage Boost and +10% PvP Damage Boost for 5s on landing [Winter's Shackles]
spec.12: Changes to mobile skill (or: Adds [Winter's Illusion] chain skill)

Frost Burst.role: Hits a frozen (or marked) target and 4 around it.

spec.12: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit (or: Changes to mobile skill)

Wish of Concentration.role: 60 s self buff: Attack, later Combat Speed and cooldowns.

Hellfire.role: Your biggest hit. Own key, hold for full charge, 45 s.

spec.12: Ignores Block and Evasion and lands as Multi-Hit (swap to Changes to mobile skill while learning a fight)

Defiance.role: Breaks stuns and knockdowns; restores 20% HP with its pick.

Fire Mark.role: Marks targets so Blaze can be used.

Robe of Earth.role: Critical Hit while MP is 50% or more.

Robe of Flame.role: Accuracy, PvE Damage Boost and Double Chance. Top passive.

Robe of Cold.role: Defense and a slow; optional at 45.

Grace of Enhancement.role: +20% PvE Damage Boost while MP is 25% or more.

Vitality Evaporation.role: Sustain passive; raise after Grace of Enhancement.

Glacial Smite.role: Instant hit on up to 4 enemies; for bosses that keep moving.

Divine Burst.role: 50 stagger damage. Swap in for stagger checks.

Assault Bombardment.role: Not used in the PvE build.

Cold Storm.role: 7 s storm: slow and Frostbite on up to 4 enemies.

Steel Barrier.role: Shield worth 20% Max HP. Use instead of Delayed Explosion while levelling solo.

Fire Wall.role: Ground fire: Embers on up to 4 enemies for 10 s.

Element Enhancement.role: +20% Fire and Water Boost for 14.5 s every 60 s. Core stigma, slot 1.

Hibernation.role: Not used in the PvE build.

Lumiel's Space.role: Not used in the PvE build.

Delayed Explosion.role: Target takes 15% more of your damage for 4 s, then explodes. Press before Hellfire.

Arctic Armor.role: Not used in the PvE build.

9.keep: Keep all 3 for level 10: Flame Arrow 5, Ice Chain 5 and Firestorm 5

14.keep: Keep 1 for level 16. Put Hellfire on its own key and hold it.

17.keep: Keep all 5 for level 19: Flame Arrow 8, Ice Chain 8, Firestorm 8 and Blaze 7

22.note: Stigma slot 1: Element Enhancement (needs the Ascension quest after the first story lock)

32.note: Stigma slot 3: Delayed Explosion (Steel Barrier if you die a lot solo)

40.note: Triniel board opens. New Stigma points go to Element Enhancement toward 10

45.keep: Keep 2 for Fire Mark 9. Then reset (free) into the 45 build

build45.alt: or Robe of Cold for its Defense

stigmas.name: Element Enhancement
stigmas.why: +20% Fire and Water Boost for 14.5 s every 60 s; at 5 +200 Accuracy; at 10 Robe of Flame counts x1.5

stigmas.name: Fire Wall
stigmas.why: Ground wall: Embers on up to 4 enemies for 10 s; at 5 extra damage on hit

stigmas.name: Delayed Explosion
stigmas.why: Target takes 15% more of your damage for 4 s, then explodes; at 5 restores 200 MP. Steel Barrier instead while levelling solo if you die often

stigmas.name: Cold Storm
stigmas.why: 7 s storm: slow and Frostbite on up to 4; at 5 extra damage on hit. Divine Burst instead for stagger checks

macro.title: Boss setup: three inputs
macro.eyebrow: hold these down for the whole fight

blocks.text: Only one of the three is a macro. The other two are single skills, each on its own input. Everything you press by hand is listed further down.

items.sub: Your basic attack. It restores MP and fills the gaps between skills. Not in the macro.

items.label: The macro (2 entries, 5 skills)
items.sub: One key that fires the 5 skills in the next box, in numbered order, 10 ms apart. This is the only thing that is stacked.
Not in the macro. Alone on its own key so it charges to full and fires the moment it is ready. Hold it, do not tap it.

blocks.text: The number is the firing order, so Bittercold Wind goes off first. Nothing else belongs in the macro on a boss: Flame Arrow and Hellfire stay on their own inputs. Some setups move Winter's Shackles into entry 1 or give Wish of Concentration its own entry; the sources split on that.

macro.title: Not in any macro: press by hand

items.why: First thing in the fight: +20% Fire and Water Boost for 14.5 s.
Just before a Hellfire, when both are ready.
Under the boss while it stands still.

macro.title: Only when the moment comes
macro.eyebrow: single presses, not in the macro

items.why: While the boss is staggered. It only hits a staggered target.
If you took it instead of Cold Storm for a stagger check: press as the stagger gauge opens, for its 50 stagger damage.
When a boss stuns you or knocks you down. It frees you and its pick restores 20% HP.
On a boss too, when the macro has nothing ready.
On a boss too: your hits have a 7% chance to mark it for 3 s, and Frost Burst can then hit it without Frost.

blocks.text: Then Hellfire comes round again well before 45 s, because each Firestorm fireball that hits takes 2 s off its cooldown. Press Delayed Explosion again before that next Hellfire. About 7 Hellfires a minute on a boss.

items.text: It is in the macro or on a key with other skills. Give it a key of its own and hold it.
Let go of the macro and fire Flame Arrows for a few seconds. Robe of Earth and Grace of Enhancement switch off when MP runs low.
Go back to the single damage line and press Winter's Shackles yourself.

items.b: Hellfire stops firing in a long fight.
items.text: The game pauses a held key after a long hold. Release the keys and hold them again.

macro.title: Trash preset
macro.eyebrow: a second skill preset for packs

blocks.text: Make a separate preset for packs. It keeps its own skill and Stigma levels and its own macro. You cannot switch presets while a Stigma is cooling down.

items.why: Gather the pack first: its Pull effect roots them.
Add it to the macro for this preset. It hits up to 4 enemies, slows 40% and has no cooldown. Most setups put it last in the macro.
By hand: Frost freezes your target for 3 s, then Frost Burst hits it and up to 4 around it.

blocks.text: Keep your 20 m range and let go of the macro between pulls so Flame Arrow refills MP.

arcana.note: The Chalice, Parchment and Mirror of Vigor with the Compass and Bell of Magic: both two-card bonuses, +60 PvE Attack while your HP is 70% or more and 1,500 MP back when your MP drops to 20% or less.

alts.text: Flame Arrow in place of Bittercold Wind once both rings are Dragon Lord rings with a Bittercold Wind line. Or Robe of Flame in place of a skill line, which leaves that skill short of 20.
Flame Arrow in place of Firestorm: Flame Arrow reaches 16 or more and Firestorm stops at 16.
Compass of Vigor (Freedom: Accuracy) while you are short of Accuracy.
Mirror of Magic (Wisdom) once you have about 35% Cooldown Reduction without Illusion.
